scope: Two tests this branch added in 9069d0feb, changed when it was merged with #1636 (OME-1739). (1) test_indexed_board_reads_rows_by_id_and_skips_ids_it_does_not_hold now calls IndexedBoard.rows_by_id instead of rows; its input and expected dict are unchanged. (2) test_only_the_selected_entries_are_checked is inverted and renamed to test_a_broken_entry_below_the_largest_selected_id_is_refused: the 50/51 entry swap with selection (181, 7, 90) is now refused as benchmark_unavailable ('not in served order'). No other existing test line is changed; new tests are appended.
reason: #1636 made IndexedBoard.rows(Sequence[int]) -> str the Cases route's read, proven by a walk from Case 1 because a check of only the selected entries cannot catch the nested-object forgery. The owner directed one shared validated read path behind two names, so grading's dict accessor became rows_by_id and inherits the walk: I/O is O(largest selected id), memory O(selected). AIDEV-NOTE: named by slug because no OME-N exists yet. The gate matcher only reads OME-*.json, and the file is new relative to origin/main, so this record is documentation until the issue is filed at PR-open; then rename it to OME-N.json and set issue and branch.
